hero_description: Bringing nature's best to your table — from Kurudu, FCT Abuja.
founder_paragraph_1: Florence Chioma, warmly known as Floxxy, is the founder of C.Zara Enterprise. Based in Kurudu, FCT, Abuja, she built the business around a simple belief: families deserve access to wholesome food they can feel good about.
founder_paragraph_2: C.Zara began with a personal commitment to carefully sourced honey and quality nuts. The business has grown through customer relationships and a continued focus on quality, care, and personal service.
founder_paragraph_3: Today, C.Zara serves households and businesses in Abuja and beyond with natural honey, nuts, palm oil, foodstuffs, and gift selections.
mission_description: We bring care, integrity, and quality to the foods we share.
mission_text: To make quality natural food products accessible to households and businesses, with care and integrity in every interaction.
vision_text: To be a trusted natural food brand known for thoughtful sourcing, dependable quality, and warm service.
values_text: Integrity in every product. Warmth in every interaction. Consistency in the care we give our customers.
process_description: A personal approach helps us bring care and attention to the foods we share.
cta_eyebrow: We'd Love to Hear from You
cta_description: Reach out to Florence for general enquiries and more information.
